thread:
frank: While onboarding I hit a snag in samples/voice README. curl uses OLD_API_KEY and points at api.redwood.ai/v0/stream -> 404.
leo: thanks, can you paste the curl snippet?
frank: ```bash
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OLD_API_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" https://api.redwood.ai/v0/stream -d '{\"text\":\"hi\"}'
```
tess: yep that's out of date. env var is REDWOOD_API_KEY and base is api.redwood-inference.com now. also JS sample imports `@redwood/inference` which is wrong.
frank: opened a small PR to fix imports, curl, and link targets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4357 - title: "fix(samples): update curl/env, correct SDK import, clarify retry defaults"
docs-bot: PR opened by frank: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4357 :sparkles:
leo: quick note: the README claims "retry behavior matches Python" which is misleading. JS client uses jittered exponential backoff by default, Python client has different defaults. add a line saying "retry defaults vary by SDK" and point to /docs/retries.md.
tess: good call. also the sample's package.json still lists node-fetch. switching to undici + type:module avoids node20 ESM issues. can we add a tiny non-blocking samples-smoke CI job to run `npm ci && node examples/voice/index.mjs` so CI catches this next time?
frank: added a non-blocking workflow in the PR and a CONTRIBUTING.md checklist item: "verify env names, example imports, and run local smoke test".
ci-bot: link-checker: broken link detected in README -> ./examples/stream/index.mjs (reported 2026-04-01T08:12:00Z)
leo: thanks for the quick fix. i'll follow up with a small issue to track a cross-SDK retry defaults page so we can avoid these ambiguous lines: #1058.
tess: moving retry-parity to product docs backlog. for now we'll merge once CI is green. :white_check_mark:
